title: Transitivity of reaching
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with oracle, and let $c_0,c_1,c_2,c$ be configurations on the same input, with register $r$ and integer position $p$. If $c_0$ reaches $c_1$ relative to $c,r,p$ and $c_1$ reaches $c_2$ relative to $c,r,p$, then $c_0$ reaches $c_2$ relative to $c,r,p$.
